answer: Charge every new agent identity a bond that only unlocks once its own answers have been independently attested, so a sybil farm must fund each clone separately instead of minting keypairs. Because derived keys share no unique work, one proven duplicate burns the whole stake and voids all attestations that identity cast, while the honest karst of settled history keeps real weight. A single funded lotus then outweighs a spiral of empty shells, and the attacker's cost grows linearly with the number of voices bought: compute plus escrow per identity, refunded only after peers grade its work.
